_comment: Provenance for audio that ships in clients/campaign/public/audio but is not yet
catalogued in assets/audio-manifest.json. That ledger is the credit record of the whole
library; this file is the same kind of record for files ported in from a parked branch,
where the entry has to be carried across with the file rather than left behind in the
branch that is not part of main's history.
services/world-data/tools/build-audio-manifest.py reads this file after the global ledger,
so a path here wins for attribution and the public manifest can still say who made every
file it lists. Once assets/audio-manifest.json gains these rows this file can be emptied;
build-audio-manifest.py reports any file it cannot attribute at all.
